nodes.name: DISCLAIMER.md
nodes.summary: Legal disclaimer outlining intended uses, user responsibilities, no-warranty terms, responsible disclosure expectations, and licensing for the SAPMAP security research tool. Requires written authorization before use.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Comprehensive project documentation covering SAPMAP's architecture, installation, CLI/GUI usage, exploitation modules (10KBlaze, BAPI, AutoPwn), LPE, SAProuter, SecStore decryption, SCC integration, scripted scenarios, and reporting. Acts as the primary entry point for users and contributors.
nodes.languageNotes: Extensive 1433-line guide with 117 sections including TOC, architecture diagrams, worked exploitation examples, YAML/JSON script formats, and CVE references.

nodes.name: requirements.txt
nodes.summary: Python runtime dependency manifest pinning required packages (bottle, requests, urllib3, pycryptodome) and documenting optional lazy-imported extras (pywebview, pyyaml, pyjks, SAPology) for feature-specific functionality.
